method: horseshoe VLM, rho=1 |V|=1; gates_vlm.json; isolated paired fins, no body, no median fins

thickness_mm.note: membrane slab plus tapered rays; a thin part (shell) for flow
membrane slab plus tapered rays; a thin part (shell) for flow
membrane slab plus tapered rays; a thin part (shell) for flow
membrane slab plus tapered rays; a thin part (shell) for flow

resolution_note: membrane and rays are not resolved by any grid here; VLM models each fin as a zero-thickness surface (the approximation), so no thickness or ray stiffness enters

regimes.note: VLM is inviscid and Re-independent; validity needs attached flow (thin boundary layers, small alpha). The listed Re only say which real regime a dCp would be converted for.
regimes.L_body_basis: body bbox x-extent (for v3a/b/c it equals candidate biology.standard_length_m)

pa_rule: delta_p_Pa = quad_dCp * dynamic_pressure_Pa[medium][speed]; pushes the fin along +quad_upper_normal
